The average treatment effect on the controls (ATC, E[Y(1) − Y(0) | T = 0]) is about **4.82**.

I fit separate linear outcome models on the 139 treated and 608 control units, using all 25 covariates. I then predicted the treated-arm outcome for each control and averaged the difference from their observed outcome. The estimate is model-based because each unit has only one observed outcome.

Other estimators on the same data:
- Doubly robust (outcome model plus logistic propensity weighting): 4.80
- OLS treatment coefficient with covariates (ATE-style): 3.95
- Naive difference in means: 4.90

ANSWER: 4.82
